structuredInstantDurationEnvelopesSepara.explanation: 265 catalogue records use {"durationType":"instant","durationValue":0,"durationUnit":"instant"} (plus 13 zero-round instant records). singleActorSelfTargetingSeparatedFromAre.explanation: 799 of 801 targetingType: "self" catalogue records are single-actor self-targets with no AoE geometry. They are now separated into self-target-schema-or-route (incompatible_authored_schema) rather than area-chain-and-multi-target-routing.

singleTargetMetadataKeysSeparatedFromAre.explanation: Single-target records carrying non-AoE metadata keys such as targetingConfig.requiresLineOfSight: true (e.g. minstrel_harmony_strike) are now classified under schema-single-target-metadata-keys (incompatible_authored_schema) rather than area-chain-and-multi-target-routing.

resourceNameVsPaymentSupportDistinction.explanation: The checker now evaluates classResourceContracts.getManagedSpellResourcePlan alongside spellConsequence.planClassPayment using both empty and funded probe banks. It distinguishes (1) supported P9 payment domains where empty-bank failure is merely an offline runtime prerequisite, (2) Minstrel cadence spells (19 records) where getBankSpellResourcePlan already plans musicalCombo.requires note deduction but resourceValues.classResource carries { cost: 3, resolvesCadence: true }, (3) conflicting sphere/devotion encodings, and (4) the 27 other classes whose resources ARE planned on the client by classResourceContracts.js but lack a server P9 room home.

authoredEffectV1ProvisionalStatusEnforce.explanation: Per docs/ENGINEERING_STATE.md and docs/MYTHRILL_CROSS_TRACK_COORDINATION.md (Finding I4), Opus P14-A10 (authored-effect:v1) is present in working-tree source but has NO completed increment/App/review acceptance handoff. The checker reports sourceObservedCompatible: true, acceptedCompatible: false, capabilityStatus: "provisional_unaccepted_source", productionReady: false, and refuses to mark it compatible/production-ready.

intentionalManualOnlyRecords.explanation: 818 records across the 9 reconstructed CR-1 classes carry explicit manualOnly: true / executionEnabled: false / applicationMode: "manual-tabletop" designations by design.

conflictingAuthoredDataRecords.explanation: Includes 13 Arcanoneer spells with explicit sphere list vs typed sphere count disagreements, 12 Martyr spells with base classResource.cost vs top-level devotionCost disagreements, 19 Minstrel cadence spells where generic classResource.cost: 3 disagrees with musicalCombo.requires note counts, and records whose effectTypes omit a populated damageConfig/healingConfig.

recordsBlockedSolelyByAuthoredSchema.explanation: Active non-manual records that require zero new engine capabilities or conflict resolutions and are blocked solely by strict P9 schema key whitelists.

B.summary: Single-target immediate storm damage spells in Minstrel whose mechanics (DICE damage + musicalCombo note payment) already exist in p9-spell:v1 and classResourceBanks.js, but are excluded by resourceValues.classResource: { type: "musical_notes", cost: 3, resolvesCadence: true } and targetingConfig.requiresLineOfSight: true (plus Class HQ confirmation of minstrel_harmony_strike resolver vs generator role).

C.title: C. Genuine shared-engine extension
C.summary: Require genuine shared-engine extensions: compound damage + debuff rider on class spells (arc_frost_touch), chain propagation (arc_fire_bolt), savingThrow metadata in P9 damage adjudication (martyr_penitent_rebuke), or caster missing-HP deterministic formula scaling (martyr_penance_of_pain).

D.title: D. Authored semantic conflict requiring a decision
D.summary: Blocked by internal authored data contradictions requiring a Class HQ design decision before any schema or engine work: arc_arcane_missile (spheres ["Arcane", "ember"] vs resourceValues { arcane_sphere: 1, holy_sphere: 1 } + autoHit: true) and martyr_redemption_strike (classResource.cost: 3 vs devotionCost: 5, and flat missing_hp_percentage formula vs +1d8 per 20% missing HP in specialMechanics).

minstrel_harmony_strike (once Class HQ confirms II+IV resolver role)
arc_arcane_missile (once Class HQ selects canonical ["arcane", "sacred"] or ["arcane", "ember"] recipe)
paymentOrSchemaLayerUnblockedForFutureIn: All 19 Minstrel cadence spells in minstrelData.js currently failing planClassPayment due to resourceValues.classResource: { cost: 3, resolvesCadence: true }
13 Arcanoneer spells with sphere recipe list vs resourceValues mismatches (once reconciled by Class HQ)
12 Martyr spells with base classResource.cost vs amplified devotionCost mismatches (once reconciled by Class HQ)
73 catalogue spells carrying targetingConfig.requiresLineOfSight: true and 265 spells carrying structured instant duration {"durationType":"instant","durationValue":0,"durationUnit":"instant"}

whatTheChangeIs: 1. Class HQ / Combat alignment on Minstrel cadence cost schema: classResourceBanks.getBankSpellResourcePlan ALREADY computes exact pitch deduction from musicalCombo.requires (e.g. ["I", "V"] for minstrel_resolving_strike). Either align resourceCost.resourceValues.classResource in minstrelData.js to omit the non-standard resolvesCadence: true flag and match musicalCombo.requires count, or allow resolvesCadence: true in spellConsequence.encodingConflict when musicalCombo.requires is present.

2. Permit or normalize non-AoE single-target schema metadata in spellConsequence.supportShape: targetingConfig.requiresLineOfSight (boolean), structured instant duration {"durationType":"instant","durationValue":0,"durationUnit":"instant"}, and descriptive damageConfig.autoHit: true (since P9 has no automated attack roll and requires GM confirmation on every execution).
3. Class HQ one-line recipe decision on arc_arcane_missile: align resourceCost.spheres with resourceCost.resourceValues ({ arcane_sphere: 1, holy_sphere: 1 } -> ["arcane", "sacred"]).
whatItCovers: Unlocks Minstrel cadence note spending in P9 so Minstrel can both build notes (minstrel_opening_chord, minstrel_harmonic_strike) and spend them on single-target immediate damage cadences (minstrel_resolving_strike, minstrel_harmony_strike) using the existing revisioned musicalNotes room home.
Unlocks arc_arcane_missile as a second Level 1 Arcanoneer immediate single-target spell alongside arc_spark_bolt.
Requires zero new server room state fields, zero new socket handlers, and zero changes to P9 owner-approval or GM-confirmation flow.
whatItExplicitlyDoesNotCover: Does NOT execute multi-round buffs, debuffs, or conditions on class spells (arc_frost_touch, arc_concussive_resonance, minstrel_perfect_cadence stay manual until compound class-spell effects are accepted).
Does NOT execute AoE, cones, lines, or chain propagation (arc_fire_bolt, minstrel_minor_cadence stay manual).
Does NOT execute simultaneous damage + healing (martyr_devoted_strike, minstrel_mending_cadence stay manual).
Does NOT execute reactions or event triggers (martyr_intervene stays manual).
Does NOT execute saving throw half-damage/negation rules or caster missing-HP formulas (martyr_penitent_rebuke, martyr_penance_of_pain, martyr_redemption_strike stay manual).
Does NOT promote unfinished Opus A10 (authored-effect:v1) to accepted production status.
